findings.finding: Two original v1 BLOCKED attempts lack separately retained invocation, exit-code, stdout and stderr captures.

findings.resolution: Keep launcher health as summary-only evidence and exclude it from accepted model-flow claims.

additional_limits: Synthetic W14-derived requirement, goal, task and principals are visible in the prompt and harness. No normal user session/message/configuration provenance is claimed.
No independent formal AcceptanceReceipt was synthesized; execution success is not runtime availability or parent completion.
No outbound wire-header capture exists. Credential-free provider behavior is supported by active route/source and receipt data only.
